mods.name: Chat Tabs
mods.description: Adds tabbed chat with automatic channel switching for servers with /g, /l, /p, and /tell commands

releases.notes:
Cleaner tab switching, a ping when someone names you, and an optional System tab.

![Chat tabs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/paraf0x/mc_chat_tabs/v1.6.4/docs/screenshots/tabs.png)

## Fixed
- **↑ in another tab no longer sends a DM.** A line typed in a DM tab used to go into chat history as `/tell Name …`; recalling it with ↑ in Local sent it as a DM again. History now keeps the plain text.
- **Tabs stay right after joining a server.** Joining while a channel tab was open left no tab highlighted, and messages in the open tab counted as unread (badge and sound).
- **Badges no longer overlap.** The unread badge ran into the close button or the next tab.
- **Settings screen fits small GUI sizes** and no longer shows labels twice ("Chat mode: Chat mode: …").

## New
- **Mention alert** (Settings → *Mention alert*, *My names*): when someone writes your player name or one of your nicknames, you get a badge and a ping — even in quiet channels. Lines without their own tab (e.g. Global) badge the All tab. Whole words only; your own lines never count.
- **System tab** (Settings → *System*): server messages like joins, shop notices and command replies in their own tab. They stay in All as well.

## Requirements
- Minecraft 26.3
- Java 25+
- Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ and Fabric API

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/paraf0x/mc_chat_tabs/compare/v1.6.3...v1.6.4

releases.notes:
Fixes for Minecraft 26.3 and for servers without a chat plugin.

## Fixed
- **Tabs react to clicks again on 26.3.** 26.3 opens its window through SDL3, which numbers the left mouse button 1 instead of 0, so every left click was ignored: tabs could not be selected or closed, and `/chattabs layout` could not be dragged.
- **Vanilla whispers open DM tabs.** `/tell`, `/msg` and `/w` on servers without a chat plugin now land in a DM tab, whatever language the client runs in.
- **No more "Unknown command" on plain servers.** A tab's join command (e.g. `/l`) is only sent when the server actually has that command.

## Requirements
- Minecraft 26.3
- Java 25+
- Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ and Fabric API

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/paraf0x/mc_chat_tabs/compare/v1.6.1...v1.6.3

releases.notes:
Republish of 1.6.0 for the Modrinth pipeline. **The mod itself is unchanged** — if you already run 1.6.0 from the GitHub release, there is nothing new here.

1.6.0's Modrinth upload served the *sources* jar: the publish workflow picked `.release.assets[0]`, and the sources jar happened to be listed first. The workflow now takes the first `.jar` that is not a `-sources` or `-dev` jar, and uploads it under its own name instead of `release-asset.jar`.

A release event reads its workflow from the tag it fires on, and `v1.6.0` predates that fix — so re-firing it would have repeated the same upload. This tag carries the fix.

## Requirements
- Minecraft 26.3
- Java 25+
- Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ and Fabric API

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/paraf0x/mc_chat_tabs/compare/v1.6.0...v1.6.1

releases.notes:
Updates Chat Tabs for **Minecraft 26.3**.

26.3 drops GLFW and creates its window through SDL3 instead, so the LWJGL GLFW classes are no longer on the classpath. Every key the mod listens for now comes from Minecraft's own `InputConstants`. Nothing about the shortcuts changes: Ctrl+Tab still cycles tabs, Up/Down still walk the history, and R still resets the peek position.

- `GLFW.GLFW_KEY_TAB` / `_UP` / `_DOWN` → `InputConstants.KEY_TAB` / `KEY_UP` / `KEY_DOWN`
- `GLFW.GLFW_KEY_R` → `InputConstants.KEY_R`
- Minecraft 26.2 → 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5, Fabric API 0.160.7+26.3
- Fabric Loom 1.18-SNAPSHOT, which needs Gradle 9.7 or newer — wrapper bumped to 9.7.1
- ModMenu 20.0.1 → 21.0.0-beta.1 (compile-only, for the config screen entry)

The access widener and all mixins apply unchanged, and the test suite is green.

## Requirements
- Minecraft 26.3
- Java 25+
- Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ and Fabric API

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/paraf0x/mc_chat_tabs/compare/v1.5.0...v1.6.0

releases.notes:
Updates Chat Tabs for **Minecraft 26.1.2**.

Minecraft 26.x ships unobfuscated and requires **Java 25**. This release ports the mod — including both mixins — to the official Mojang names and adapts to the 26.1.x GUI rendering refactor (`DrawContext` → `GuiGraphicsExtractor` extract-render-state pipeline, `ChatHud` → `ChatComponent`, new input event types). The chat layout offset is re-implemented against the new pipeline.

## Requirements
- Minecraft 26.1.2
- Java 25+
- Fabric Loader 0.19.2+ and Fabric API

## Note
The mixins target the refactored 26.1.x chat internals. If a future 26.1.x patch shifts those internals again, the in-game tab behaviour may need a follow-up — please file an issue with the log.

readmeSummary: A client-side Fabric mod that adds tabbed chat to Minecraft. Automatically sorts messages into All, Local, and per-player DM tabs based on server chat prefixes ([G], [L], /tell).
